title: Junior Graphic Designer
note: Part-time union role in the Exhibitions department designing exhibition graphics and signage.

facts.duties: Assist the lead designer on exhibition graphics, signage and branded materials; prepare concepts, layouts and production-ready files.
facts.requirements: Bachelor's degree in graphic design, visual communication or similar; InDesign, Illustrator and Photoshop; some fabrication and print experience.
facts.apply: Apply through the Built In Chicago job page.
